src:
MOV     DX, OFFSET SHRINKM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 4Ah          ; DOS: resize the block at ES (our PSP)
MOV     BX, 1000h        ; 64 KB
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; ok
MOV     DX, OFFSET OURSM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AX, CS           ; our MCB: the paragraph below the PSP
DEC     AX
MOV     ES, AX
XOR     DI, DI
MOV     AX, ES:[DI+3]    ; its size field
CALL    PHEX             ; 1000
MOV     DX, OFFSET PARASM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
PUSH    CS
POP     ES               ; ES = our PSP again
MOV     DX, OFFSET GROWM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 4Ah
MOV     BX, 0FFFFh       ; more than there can be
INT     21h
MOV     MAX1, BX         ; BX = the most we can have
CALL    RESULT           ; error 8
MOV     DX, OFFSET ALLM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 4Ah
MOV     BX, MAX1
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; ok

SHRINKM1 DB     "shrink to 64 KB: $"
OURSM1  DB      "our block: $"
PARASM1 DB      "h paragraphs", 13, 10, "$"
GROWM1  DB      "grow to FFFFh paragraphs: $"
ALLM1   DB      "grow to all there is: $"
MAX1    DW      0
RESULT  PROC    NEAR     ; print "ok", or "error" and AX when CF = 1
PUSHF                    ; keeps AX and CF for the caller
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET OKMSG
JNC     RESULT1
MOV     DX, OFFSET ERRMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
PUSH    AX
CALL    PDEC             ; the error code
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
RESULT1:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
POPF
RET
RESULT  ENDP
OKMSG   DB      "ok", 13, 10, "$"
ERRMSG  DB      "error $"
PDEC    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX in decimal (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX           ; digits on the stack
PDEC1:
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; AX = AX / 10, DX = the last digit
PUSH    DX
INC     CX
OR      AX, AX
JNZ     PDEC1
PDEC2:
POP     DX               ; the digits come back first to last
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC2
RET
PDEC    ENDP
PHEX    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX as four hex digits (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, AX
MOV     CX, 4
PHEX1:
PUSH    CX
MOV     CL, 4
ROL     BX, CL           ; the top digit to the bottom
POP     CX
MOV     DL, BL
AND     DL, 0Fh
ADD     DL, "0"
CMP     DL, "9"
JBE     PHEX2
ADD     DL, 7            ; "A" to "F"
PHEX2:
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PHEX1
RET
PHEX    ENDP
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
